title: 第二十九章 剑帝古城，中州风云
content_zh:
联军溃败的消息，如同飓风般席卷东荒和中州。天剑宗与林墨之名，再次被推上了风口浪尖。所有人都知道，天剑宗背后，似乎站着一位难以想象的古老存在，而林墨，则是那个被古老存在看中的“天命之人”。

    联军虽然暂时退却，但并未解散，而是在东荒与中州的交界处驻扎下来，虎视眈眈，显然在等待更合适的时机，或者更强大的援军。

    天剑宗赢得了宝贵的喘息之机，但所有人都清楚，这只是暂时的平静。更大的风暴，正在酝酿。

    天剑宗后山，无名太上的洞府中。

    “你要去中州？去剑帝城？”无名太上听完林墨的决定，沉默了片刻，缓缓问道。

    “是。”林墨神色坚定，“弟子思前想后，若要彻底解决‘锈’患，找到唤醒洛璃师姐的方法，并真正掌握剑皇前辈留下的力量，剑帝城，是唯一的线索。那里是剑皇前辈证道之地，必定隐藏着更深层次的秘密。”

    “剑帝城……”无名太上眼中闪过一丝复杂的光芒，“那是中州最古老的遗迹之一，传闻乃是剑皇成道时所居之城，后随剑皇消失而隐没于虚空乱流之中。每隔百年，才会在特定时间、特定地点，短暂现世。每一次现世，都会引得中州乃至整个大陆的剑修趋之若鹜，但真正能从中获得机缘者，寥寥无几。”

    “而且，中州是轩辕帝族和战族的地盘。你如今是他们眼中钉、肉中刺，此行无异于自投罗网。”

    “弟子知道。”林墨点头，“但弟子别无选择。而且，最危险的地方，往往也是最安全的地方。他们恐怕也想不到，我敢在这个时候，潜入中州。”

    无名太上看着林墨那坚定的眼神，仿佛看到了当年那个同样意气风发、为了心中信念敢闯任何龙潭虎穴的自己。他最终点了点头：“也罢。雏鹰终要翱翔九天，宝剑也需历经磨砺。你既然已经决定了，老夫便不再阻拦。不过，中州不比东荒，强者如云，势力错综复杂。你此行，务必万事小心。”

    他伸手，从怀中取出一枚古朴的、仿佛由青铜铸成的剑形令牌，递给林墨：“此乃‘剑帝令’，是当年剑皇前辈赠予我天剑宗祖师的信物。持此令，可在剑帝城中，获得一次进入‘剑皇悟道台’的机会。那里，或许有你想要寻找的答案。”

    林墨郑重地接过剑帝令，入手冰凉，上面刻着一个苍劲有力的“帝”字，隐隐散发出一股浩瀚的剑意。

    “多谢前辈！”

    “去吧。”无名太上摆了摆手，“记住，无论遇到什么困难，天剑宗，永远是你的后盾。”

    林墨对着无名太上深深一礼，然后转身，离开了洞府。
content_en:
The news of the defeat of the coalition forces swept through the Eastern Wasteland and Zhongzhou like a hurricane. The names of Tianjian Sect and Lin Mo were once again brought to the forefront. Everyone knew that behind the Tianjian Sect, there seemed to be an unimaginable ancient being standing, and Lin Mo was the "man of destiny" who was favored by the ancient being.

    Although the coalition forces temporarily retreated, they did not disband. Instead, they stationed themselves at the junction of Donghuang and Zhongzhou, watching eagerly, obviously waiting for a more suitable time or stronger reinforcements.

    Tianjian Sect won a precious breathing space, but everyone knew that this was only a temporary calm. A bigger storm is brewing.

    In the back mountain of Tianjian Sect, in the cave of Wuming Taishang.

    "Are you going to Zhongzhou? To Sword Emperor City?" After hearing Lin Mo's decision, Wuming Taishang was silent for a moment and asked slowly.

    "Yes." Lin Mo looked determined, "After careful consideration, if the disciple wants to completely solve the 'rust' problem, find a way to awaken Senior Sister Luo Li, and truly grasp the power left by the senior Sword Emperor, the Sword Emperor City is the only clue. It is the place where the senior Sword Emperor achieved enlightenment, and there must be deeper secrets hidden there."

    "Sword Emperor City..." A complicated light flashed in the eyes of the nameless Supreme Being, "It is one of the oldest relics in Zhongzhou. It is rumored that it was the city where the Sword Emperor lived when he became enlightened. After that, he disappeared and disappeared into the turbulence of the void. Every hundred years, it will briefly appear at a specific time and place. Every time it appears, it will attract sword cultivators from Zhongzhou and even the entire continent to flock to it, but there are only a few who can really get an opportunity from it."

    "Moreover, Zhongzhou is the territory of the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan and the Zhan Clan. You are now a thorn in their side and a thorn in their flesh. This trip is tantamount to throwing yourself into a trap."

    "Disciple knows." Lin Mo nodded, "But disciple has no choice. Moreover, the most dangerous place is often the safest place. I'm afraid they can't imagine that I dare to sneak into Zhongzhou at this time."

    The Nameless Supreme Being looked at Lin Mo's firm eyes, as if he saw the same high-spirited self who dared to break into any dragon or tiger's den for the sake of his belief. He finally nodded: "Forget it. The young eagle will eventually fly to the nine heavens, and the sword will also need to be tempered. Now that you have made your decision, I will no longer stop you. However, Zhongzhou is no better than Donghuang, with powerful people like the clouds and complicated forces. You must be careful in everything during this trip."

    He reached out and took out a simple sword-shaped token made of bronze from his arms, and handed it to Lin Mo: "This is the 'Sword Emperor Order', which was a token given to me by the senior Sword Emperor back then, the founder of the Heavenly Sword Sect. With this order, you can get an opportunity to enter the 'Sword Emperor Enlightenment Platform' in the Sword Emperor City. There may be the answer you want to find there."

    Lin Mo solemnly took the Sword Emperor Order and held it cold in his hands. There was a vigorous and powerful word "Emperor" engraved on it, faintly exuding a vast sword intent.

    "Thank you, senior!"

    "Go ahead." Wuming Taishang waved his hand, "Remember, no matter what difficulties you encounter, Tianjian Sect will always be your backing."

    Lin Mo bowed deeply to the unknown Supreme Being, then turned around and left the cave.
title_en: Chapter 29 The ancient city of Sword Emperor, the situation in Zhongzhou
